Add a versioned schema and CI checker. The status ladder is pending|candidate|landed|released; candidate and later states require proving_tests, candidate requires candidate_head, landed requires landed_sha, released requires the tag; kept requires its relationship test. For repo=aweb, files and test IDs exist at HEAD; candidate_head is an ancestor when landed. The TS candidate paths become locally required when its branch joins the train.

Require ed25519_profile=strict|legacy per verify row, established from its exact call sites. Track aweb-acmz in this same inventory; preserve released-family rulings and split mixed rows rather than guessing a profile.
For non-aweb repos, pin an exact SHA and run an equivalent repository guard, or have the release gate read that repo own guarded inventory. Missing external evidence fails qualification.
